header.name: Neo's More Mobs + Alex's Mobs
header.description: 100 mobs in one pack: the Alex's Mobs 1.22.9 Bedrock port plus Neo's original mobs. Duplicates removed. Includes graveyard structures where Forgotten Souls spawn, Miner Zombies and the Void Dealer trader.
